can_do_en: I can tell a pharmacist what's wrong and since when, understand how often and how much medicine to take, and ask what to do if it doesn't get better.

dialogue.speaker: 藥師
dialogue.en: Hi, what can I get you?

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zh: 我肚子不太舒服，從今天早上開始就一直拉肚子。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄉㄨˋ ˙ㄗ ㄅㄨˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄕㄨ ˙ㄈㄨ ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄐㄧㄣ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄗㄠˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄎㄞ ㄕˇ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄧ ㄓˊ ㄌㄚ ㄉㄨˋ ˙ㄗ
dialogue.en: My stomach doesn't feel great. I've had diarrhea since this morning.

dialogue.speaker: 藥師
dialogue.zh: 有沒有發燒？你昨天吃了什麼？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄧㄡˇ ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄈㄚ ㄕㄠ ㄋㄧˇ ㄗㄨㄛˊ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄔ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄕㄣˊ ˙ㄇㄜ
dialogue.en: Any fever? What did you eat yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zh: 沒有發燒。昨天晚上去夜市吃了很多辣的，還喝了很多冰的。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄈㄚ ㄕㄠ ㄗㄨㄛˊ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄨㄢˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄧㄝˋ ㄕˋ ㄔ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄌㄚˋ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄏㄞˊ ㄏㄜ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄅㄧㄥ ˙ㄉㄜ
dialogue.en: No fever. Last night I went to the night market and ate a lot of spicy food, and I drank a lot of cold drinks too.

dialogue.speaker: 藥師
dialogue.zh: 那應該是吃壞肚子了。這個藥一天吃三次，一次一顆，飯後吃。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄚˋ ㄧㄥ ㄍㄞ ㄕˋ ㄔ ㄏㄨㄞˋ ㄉㄨˋ ˙ㄗ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄓㄜˋ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄧㄠˋ ㄧ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄔ ㄙㄢ ㄘˋ ㄧ ㄘˋ ㄧ ㄎㄜ ㄈㄢˋ ㄏㄡˋ ㄔ
dialogue.en: Then something you ate probably upset your stomach. Take this medicine three times a day, one tablet each time, after meals.

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄋㄚˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄏㄜ ㄎㄚ ㄈㄟ ˙ㄇㄚ
dialogue.en: OK. Can I drink coffee, then?

dialogue.speaker: 藥師
dialogue.zh: 這兩天先不要喝。吃東西也要小心一點，不要吃辣的跟冰的，多喝溫開水。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄅㄨˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄏㄜ ㄔ ㄉㄨㄥ ˙ㄒㄧ ㄧㄝˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄧ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄔ ㄌㄚˋ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄍㄣ ㄅㄧㄥ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄏㄜ ㄨㄣ ㄎㄞ ㄕㄨㄟˇ
dialogue.en: Skip it for the next couple of days. Be a bit more careful about what you eat, too: no spicy food and nothing cold. Drink plenty of warm water.

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zh: 知道了。還有，我的腳被蚊子咬了好多包，好癢喔。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓ ㄉㄠˋ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄏㄞˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄨㄛˇ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄐㄧㄠˇ ㄅㄟˋ ㄨㄣˊ ˙ㄗ ㄧㄠˇ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄏㄠˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄅㄠ ㄏㄠˇ ㄧㄤˇ ㄛ
dialogue.en: Got it. Also, mosquitoes bit my legs all over, and they're so itchy.

dialogue.speaker: 藥師
dialogue.zh: 我們屏東蚊子很多啦。你可以擦這條藥膏，洗了澡就擦一點。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ˙ㄇㄣ ㄆㄧㄥˊ ㄉㄨㄥ ㄨㄣˊ ˙ㄗ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ˙ㄌㄚ ㄋㄧˇ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄘㄚ ㄓㄜˋ ㄊㄧㄠˊ ㄧㄠˋ ㄍㄠ ㄒㄧˇ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄗㄠˇ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄘㄚ ㄧ ㄉㄧㄢˇ
dialogue.en: We've got a lot of mosquitoes here in Pingtung. You can use this cream: put a little on right after your shower.

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄧ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄧㄠˋ ㄘㄚ ㄐㄧˇ ㄘˋ
dialogue.en: How many times a day should I put it on?

dialogue.speaker: 藥師
dialogue.zh: 一天擦兩三次就可以了。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄧ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄘㄚ ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄙㄢ ㄘˋ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ˙ㄌㄜ
dialogue.en: Two or three times a day is enough.

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zh: 好。如果明天還是一直拉肚子，怎麼辦？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄏㄞˊ ㄕˋ ㄧ ㄓˊ ㄌㄚ ㄉㄨˋ ˙ㄗ ㄗㄣˇ ˙ㄇㄜ ㄅㄢˋ
dialogue.en: OK. And if I still have diarrhea tomorrow, what should I do?

dialogue.speaker: 藥師
dialogue.zh: 那就要去看醫生喔。這盒藥一百二，藥膏一百八，一共三百。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄚˋ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄎㄢˋ ㄧ ㄕㄥ ㄛ ㄓㄜˋ ㄏㄜˊ ㄧㄠˋ ㄧ ㄅㄞˇ ㄦˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄍㄠ ㄧ ㄅㄞˇ ㄅㄚ ㄧ ㄍㄨㄥˋ ㄙㄢ ㄅㄞˇ
dialogue.en: Then you should go and see a doctor. The box of medicine is 120 and the cream is 180, so 300 altogether.

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄓㄜˋ ㄕˋ ㄙㄢ ㄅㄞˇ ㄎㄨㄞˋ ㄒㄧㄝˋ ˙ㄒㄧㄝ

vocab.en: to begin; 從……開始 starting from…
bad, broken; 吃壞肚子 to get an upset stomach from something you ate
measure word for tablets and other small round things
to bite; 被蚊子咬 bitten by mosquitoes
measure word for long thin things, and for a tube of cream
to take a shower or bath; split as 洗了澡
what should I do? what now?

grammar.note_en: The pharmacist says 洗了澡就擦一點: put the cream on right after your shower. 了 goes straight after the first verb (洗了澡) and 就 straight before the second; the writing model does the same with 吃了飯就吃一顆.
吃東西要小心一點: an adjective + 一點 asks for 'a bit more' of that quality, here 'be a bit more careful about what you eat'. Don't mix it up with 有一點 before an adjective, which means 'somewhat' (unit L2-03).
Anna states the problem first and puts 怎麼辦 at the end: 如果明天還是一直拉肚子，怎麼辦？ 'If I still have diarrhea tomorrow, what should I do?'

pronunciation.note_en: Aspiration: ㄉ in 肚子 ㄉㄨˋ ˙ㄗ has no puff of air, ㄊ in 條 ㄊㄧㄠˊ and 一天 ㄧ ㄊㄧㄢ has a strong one (肚子 / 兔子 ㄊㄨˋ ˙ㄗ is a classic pair). In the same way, ㄍ in 藥膏 ㄧㄠˋ ㄍㄠ has no puff and ㄎ in 一顆 ㄧ ㄎㄜ has one; ㄗ in 洗澡 ㄒㄧˇ ㄗㄠˇ has none and ㄘ in 擦 ㄘㄚ and 三次 ㄙㄢ ㄘˋ has one. Tone pair 4+1 (a high fall, then high and level): 藥師 ㄧㄠˋ ㄕ, 藥膏 ㄧㄠˋ ㄍㄠ; jump back up for the second syllable instead of letting it fall too. Sandhi: 一次一顆 is said ㄧˊ ㄘˋ ㄧˋ ㄎㄜ, 不要 ㄅㄨˊ ㄧㄠˋ, 一共 ㄧˊ ㄍㄨㄥˋ, and the word 洗澡 on its own ㄒㄧˊ ㄗㄠˇ (3+3).

speaking.prompt_en: You're at a pharmacy in Pingtung. Tell the pharmacist what's wrong and since when, answer whether you have a fever, ask how to take the medicine, and ask what to do if you're not better tomorrow.
speaking.prompt_zh: 你在藥局。請跟藥師說你哪裡不舒服、從什麼時候開始的、有沒有發燒，然後問藥怎麼吃，還有如果明天還是不舒服，怎麼辦。
checklist_en: said what's wrong (我肚子不太舒服 / 一直拉肚子)
said since when with 從……開始
asked how often and how much (一天吃幾次？一次幾顆？)
kept unaspirated ㄉ (肚子) and aspirated ㄊ (一天) apart

writing.prompt_en: You went to a pharmacy today. Write a short LINE message (3–5 sentences) to a friend: what was wrong, what the pharmacist said, and how you take the medicine. Try 了……就…… and 小心一點.
writing.prompt_zh: 你今天去了藥局。請寫一個短短的LINE訊息給朋友：你怎麼了、藥師說了什麼、藥要怎麼吃。
writing.model_zh: 我昨天晚上在夜市吃了很多辣的，今天一直拉肚子。下午我去藥局買藥，藥師說我應該是吃壞肚子了。這個藥一天吃三次，吃了飯就吃一顆。藥師還說這兩天吃東西要小心一點。如果明天還是不舒服，我就去看醫生。

culture_en: Neighbourhood pharmacies (社區藥局) in Taiwan are run by licensed pharmacists (藥師), and for a small problem like an upset stomach or mosquito bites you can describe it at the counter and buy medicine there without seeing a doctor. Taiwan sorts medicines into three groups: prescription drugs (處方藥), which need a doctor's prescription (處方箋); pharmacist-advised drugs (指示藥); and over-the-counter drugs (成藥). If a clinic gives you a prescription instead of the medicine itself, take it with your 健保卡 to a pharmacy with a 健保特約藥局 sign. When you're ill, pharmacists and family will often tell you to drink 溫開水 and avoid 冰的.
